overview: Vah Shir Outskirts is the frontier zone where Vah Shir hunters train, patrol, and defend Shar Vahl from threats emerging in Shadeweaver’s Thicket.
history: Shar Vahl established hunter lodges along the savanna edge.
Patrol posts were built to monitor Grimling movement.
Shadow corruption began creeping toward the outskirts.
Wildlife ranges became unstable due to thicket influence.
Seru scouts attempted to map the outskirts but were turned away.
hooks: A Vah Shir patrol reports corrupted wildlife near the thicket edge.
Grimling scouts attempt to infiltrate the outskirts.
A hunter lodge requests aid against a prowling beast.
Shadow corruption spreads toward Shar Vahl’s gate.
